_comment: The `meta` theme's text (content sets R3). Every line is true of every world the pack can be used in: it names only what every generated world has (rooms, exits, checks, items, rules, a seed). {placeholder} templates: {item} in a gate's lines is filled at GENERATION by the placer (the item the gate's rule asks for); the rest are filled at PLAY by the substrate that shows them (the text adventure's templating.js): {destinationRegion} in a gate's lines, {item} in a check's. Characters' `says` and information's `body` (content sets S1) are filled at GENERATION: {roomName} (the room's place name) and {regionId} (its region id). ⛓ Content sets S2: a key ending `/maze` is the MAZE's own line for the key before it (`resolveRole`'s variant): a maze region has no place name, so the two characters' maze lines name its region id instead; filled at GENERATION ({regionId}).

r3.note: the meta theme, content sets R3 (841d5d27cb, Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5). The user's review of the R3/R4 words and art is logged as open, so no approval is recorded

s1.note: content sets S1 (56c87f0ab9 and e5ef790ff8, Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5): the Narrator, the Placeholder, the three pieces of information and the Gate's {item} lines; the user approved S1's words on 2026-11-14

s2.note: content sets S2 (e8e7ce6cc0, Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5): the maze variants of the Narrator's and the Placeholder's lines, and their maze shapes and the sign's; the user approved S2's words and shapes on 2026-11-14

strings.meta:concept/guardian/blocked: The Gate stays shut. Its rule is one item, {item}, and you do not have it. Come back with it and the way to {destinationRegion} opens.
strings.meta:concept/guardian/passedWith: The Gate checks for {item} and finds it. That is its whole rule, so it opens. The way to {destinationRegion} is clear.
strings.meta:concept/sword/checkMessage: This location is a check. You checked it and received {item}. A rule that asks only for this item now passes.
strings.meta:concept/swim/checkMessage: This location is a check. You checked it and received {item}. A rule that asks only for this item now passes.
strings.meta:character/narrator/says: This is {roomName}. The rules know it as {regionId}.
strings.meta:character/narrator/says/maze: The rules know this room as {regionId}.
strings.meta:character/placeholder/says: Sorry about the name. {roomName} was picked from a short list, not written for this room.
strings.meta:character/placeholder/says/maze: Sorry about the name. {regionId} is the id the generator gave this region; nobody wrote it for this room.
strings.meta:info/checks/body: A check is a location that sends an item. Reading this is not a check: nothing is sent.
strings.meta:info/exits/body: An exit with a rule opens when its rule passes. The rule is fixed when the world is generated.
strings.meta:info/rooms/body: Each room here is one region of the world's rules. An exit takes you to another region.
